annotations.title: Designations on a red line: present, absent, not checked

description:
Every planning and environmental designation on a red line, a piece of
    land or a point, from the current published layers: green belt, National
    Landscapes, national parks, SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, ancient woodland,
    nature reserves, nutrient neutrality, listed buildings, scheduled
    monuments, registered parks and battlefields, world heritage sites and
    buffers, heritage at risk, flood zones 2 and 3, historic floods, coal
    high-risk areas, access land, agricultural land class, conservation
    areas, Article 4, TPOs, the brownfield register, archaeological priority
    areas, open space and air quality areas.

    THREE-VALUED. Each answers `present` (with the share of the site it
    covers and up to five features with grade and reference), `absent` (with
    the distance to the nearest within 2 km) or `not_checked` with the
    reason: the layer is loaded for England only, it is not loaded yet, or
    the site's council has published none. not_checked is never a clean
    result. `buffer_m` (0-2000) widens the scope. Give exactly ONE scope: `location` ("lat,lng"), `postcode`,
    `area_geojson` (a red line, GeoJSON in WGS84, at most 150 km² and 64
    vertices), `land_id` or `lpa_code` (GSS, e.g. E07000240); anything else is
    refused before any read and nothing is charged. UK only. Free.
